channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Area Calendar, March 24-25, 2026
item.description: Area sports calendar for March 24-25, 2026: A full slate of college and high school baseball, softball, soccer, lacrosse, golf, track and more across the region.

item.title: MIDDLE SCHOOL ROUNDUP: Vikings hold hit parade, allow none by Bucks
item.description: Elm City’s middle school teams dominate on the diamond and pitch — with a baseball no-hitter and 7-0 girls soccer shutout — while Vikings boys tennis falls 5-4 to Williamston.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Cyclones’ late flurry finishes Bruins
item.description: Community Christian softball’s 21-11 walk-off, Cyclones girls soccer’s 7-1 rematch win, Wilson Christian baseball and soccer setbacks, and Fike tennis’ 7-0 sweep headline Monday’s area prep slate.

item.title: Greenfield’s Edwards earns USA Today All-USA acclaim
item.description: After leading Greenfield to its first NCISAA 2-A title, senior guard Kobe Edwards was named to USA Today’s All-USA East second team, becoming the program’s second All-America pick after Coby White.

item.title: McKenzie’s near no-no sparks Knights in nonconference romp
item.description: Greenfield lefty Zach McKenzie carried a no-hitter into the fifth and finished with a one-hitter and 3 RBIs as the Knights routed Northwood Temple 11-1 in five innings in nonconference play.

item.title: NC utilities commissioner warns against ‘throwing good money after bad...
item.description: NC utilities commissioner Donald van der Vaart likens Duke Energy's solar buildout to buying seven unreliable cars and warns the added costs may fall on ratepayers.

item.title: Rural residents face the biggest risks from postal delays
item.description: USPS cuts to evening mail pickups at rural post offices mean ballots, tax returns and bill payments may be postmarked late, risking voter disenfranchisement and higher costs for seniors without broadband.

item.title: This year, the case against lawns gets even stronger
item.description: Rising fuel and fertilizer costs tied to Middle East conflict sharpen the case against traditional lawns, highlighting their time, financial, legal and environmental burdens compared to more natural yards.

item.title: Man charged in stabbing, robbery
item.description: Wilson man charged with stabbing, robbery after early-morning attack at G.K. Butterfield Train Station; victim treated for minor injuries, suspect held without bond.

item.title: Houston, Jags no-hit Bruins in EPC softball opener
item.description: Corri Houston tossed a three-inning no-hitter with eight strikeouts as Farmville Central routed Beddingfield 17-0 in a mercy-rule Eastern Plains Conference opener.

item.title: Wilson County deed transfers recorded week of March 9-13
item.description: Wilson County recorded more than 20 property transfers for March 9-13, including Sandy Ridge Mobile Home Park, a $5.5 million Ward Boulevard site and multiple residential parcels across the county.

item.title: Wilson seeks FEMA funds to demolish 49 flood-damaged public housing bu...
item.description: Wilson has applied for a FEMA grant to demolish 49 flood-prone public housing buildings in the Hominy Creek watershed, cutting blight and supporting wider flood-control and greenway projects.

item.title: Seven errors doom Beddingfield in 15-0 loss to Farmville Central
item.description: Seven errors and one hit doom Beddingfield as Farmville Central’s Chase Felton strikes out 12 in a 15-0 mercy-rule win in the Eastern Plains Conference opener; the teams play again Friday in Farmville.

item.title: Barton College launches strategic plan
item.description: Barton College’s new 2026–2030 strategic plan, “For Each and All,” expands high-demand programs like bioengineering and AI and boosts tech-rich, personalized learning with new labs and digital upgrades.

item.title: Moore-Massey mound combo leads Hunt past NN for 4-0 Big East start
item.description: Trevor Moore and Stone Massey combined on a four-hitter as Hunt beat Northern Nash 6-3, staying unbeaten in 5-A/6-A Big East play and improving to 4-0 atop the standings.
